name: Filtered Back-Projection for Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering technique that reconstructs density values at arbitrary sample points along a ray directly from 2D projections, avoiding the intermediate step of creating a 3D rectilinear grid. It uses Filtered Back-Projection to compute density and gradients.
summary: Filtered Back-Projection for Volume Rendering reconstructs density directly from 2D projections, avoiding 3D grids to eliminate interpolation errors and improve thin structure quality.
